items.Sentence: Gravity sewer lines convey the wastewater to primary clarification community septic tanks.

Following the septic tanks, wastewater is conveyed to a lift station with duplex pumps (each pump rated at 95 gallons per minute at 142 feet total dynamic head). The wastewater is discharged from the lift station to a leach field through a four-inch diameter force main.
Sludge was removed from the septic tanks from a qualified contractor in 2021.
The operator estimates that sludge will be removed once every five years.
